GPTR-F-001-S173.title: Allowlist Configuration Loader and Versioning
GPTR-F-001-S173.description: Implement a configuration loader that retrieves the allowlist schema from a controlled source, supports versioning, and ensures the enforcement engine always uses a validated, immutable snapshot during request execution.

GPTR-F-001-S174.title: Structured Enforcement Error Contract
GPTR-F-001-S174.description: Define and implement a standardized error response contract for all enforcement failures, including error codes, violation type, and safe diagnostic metadata without exposing sensitive schema details.

GPTR-F-001-S175.title: Enforcement Audit Logging and Traceability
GPTR-F-001-S175.description: Extend GPTReader logging to capture allowlist enforcement decisions, including rejected queries, rule violations, and request metadata for audit and QA traceability.

GPTR-F-001-S176.title: Query Normalization Pre-Processor
GPTR-F-001-S176.description: Implement a preprocessing step that normalizes incoming GPTReader queries (field casing, operator standardization, structural validation) prior to allowlist enforcement to prevent bypass via malformed inputs.
